# Versions of: Memory is a lifecycle

1 published version of [Memory is a lifecycle: a reply to Francois Vanderseypen on Neo4j's Relate, agreeing that a graph database is not agent memory, and showing how we answer his four questions, what gets written, trusted, merged and forgotten, with append lanes, signed commits, git-like graph merges and new versions instead of edits, all in encrypted vaults rather than a database](../memory-is-a-lifecycle.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out.
